scope: Bounded qualification of an industrial-incident source; supplements the existing source register. No new broad research, product ingestion or automatic source release.

authority.original_task: Erwan asked for deep sector/government/timber research and full chain coordination in the product chat.

sources.hash_scope: Raw HTTP response bytes; not a product collector contentHash.
sources.temporal_limit: Metadata alone does not prove which facts were public on the event day. The current retrospective text contains the later duration of the stoppage. No contemporaneous alert or prediction claimed.

establishment.site_description: Wood-sawdust production plant; drying tunnel and silos affected.
establishment.identity_limit: The record does not name a legal entity. Do not attach a real commercial counterparty by city or activity alone.

operational_consequences_reported.fact: A fire damaged the production site and caused production to stop for fifteen days.
Three silos, each with a capacity of 50 cubic metres, and part of the roof were affected.

not_established: The actual material volume lost; silo capacity is not inventory loss.
A dated restart confirmation or operational state on 22 October.
Any supplier, competitor, customer or geographical-neighbour link to the synthetic customer.
A demand increase, selling price, margin, available alternative stock or actual delivery delay.
sources.recommended_use: Explicitly dated recorded or retrospective scenario only. Never present as a current October interruption or imply the fifteen-day outcome was known in advance.
company_fields_needed: Explicitly attributed synthetic scenario relation or verified legal/site relationship
Exact material/SKU mapping and unit; source describes technical sawdust
Affected purchase line, arrival dates, quantities and current internal confirmation
All current commitments, reservations, usable stock and logistics options
For the positive branch: separately qualified CRM demand, compatible product, quantity, delivery date and commercial terms
For a competitor-neighbour premise: independent evidence or explicit fictional scenario data
sources.release_policy: Builder source card only. Data owner must receive and validate original public evidence through the accepted product intake; card/receipts are not product knowledge.

sources.hash_scope: Raw HTTP response bytes; not a product collector contentHash.
sources.temporal_limit: Historical statement. No independently archived first version or current October operating status received.

establishment.products_as_published: Finished products, no SKU named; packaging materials mainly affected.

operational_consequences_reported.fact: The manufacturer reports a contained storage fire and damage to part of its stock.
The manufacturer states that industrial activity at the site was unaffected.

not_established: Production shutdown; this would contradict the published statement.
Specific products, damaged quantities, lots or customer delivery delays.
That all stock or all deliveries were unaffected merely because production continued.
Any actual supplier/competitor/customer relationship with the synthetic company.
Any competitor-neighbour damage, incremental demand, commercial price or margin.
sources.recommended_use: Recorded insulation/materials scenario or negative control against an unsupported production-shutdown claim. A stock-delivery risk still requires an exact internal lot/order relationship and current confirmation.
company_fields_needed: Attributed synthetic relation or verified legal/site relationship
Affected order/lot and actual stock origin/location
Separate internal confirmation of availability or delay
Compatible free stock after all commitments, logistics and quote terms
Qualified CRM need/quantity/date/price for any positive branch
sources.release_policy: Public facts can enter only through accepted source intake. Relationship, demand and numbers are separately attributed company/scenario facts.

excluded_candidates.reason: Original still returns HTTP403 through both web reader and ordinary host GET; no bypass. Search index reports normal operation after packaging-material fire, so it must not be used as evidence of production shutdown.

previous_boundary: ROCKWOOL future plant construction does not establish next-day disruption.

next_owner_actions.data: Test accepted product intake of original and preserve dates, anonymous identity and retrospective scope.
next_owner_actions.integrator: Receive matching synthetic business relations and chronology before source/case binding; preserve independent source and company evidence.
next_owner_actions.portfolio: Choose a genuinely matching product/scenario or reject this source for the chosen customer. Do not relabel insulation as sawdust.
next_owner_actions.product_owner: Use a recorded scenario label if this historical incident is selected; otherwise keep the controlled fire separate from real-source proof.

preferred_materials_case: ROCKWOOL is closer to the existing insulation demonstrator, but supports stock damage with production continuing, not a production shutdown. ARIA supports a historical 15-day stop for technical sawdust, which requires a different material mapping.
